[package]
name = "ksni"
version = "0.3.6"
authors = ["iovxw <iovxw@outlook.com>"]
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.80"
description = "A Rust implementation of the KDE/freedesktop StatusNotifierItem specification\n"
repository = "https://github.com/iovxw/ksni"
keywords = ["systray", "linux", "gui"]
categories = ["api-bindings"]
license = "Unlicense"
exclude = ["reference/", "spec/"]

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
features = ["blocking"]

[features]
default = ["tokio"]
blocking = []
node = []
tokio = ["dep:tokio", "zbus/tokio"]
async-io = ["dep:async-io", "dep:async-lock", "dep:async-executor", "dep:futures-lite", "dep:futures-channel", "dep:task-local", "zbus/async-io"]

[dependencies]
pastey = "0.2"
futures-util = "0.3"

[dependencies.zbus]
version = "5"
default-features = false

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = ["rt", "macros"]
optional = true

[dependencies.async-io]
version = "2"
optional = true

[dependencies.async-lock]
version = "3"
optional = true

[dependencies.async-executor]
version = "1"
optional = true

[dependencies.futures-lite]
version = "2"
optional = true

[dependencies.futures-channel]
version = "0.3"
optional = true

[dependencies.task-local]
version = "0.1"
optional = true

[dev-dependencies]
smol = "2"
smol-macros = "0.1"
macro_rules_attribute = "0.2"
image = "0.25"
chrono = "0.4"

[dev-dependencies.zbus]
version = "5"
default-features = false
features = ["blocking-api"]

[dev-dependencies.ashpd]
version = "0.13"
default-features = false
features = ["async-io"]

[[example]]
name = "async"
required-features = ["tokio"]
doc-scrape-examples = true

[[example]]
name = "async_smol"
required-features = ["async-io"]
doc-scrape-examples = false

[[example]]
name = "blocking"
required-features = ["blocking"]
doc-scrape-examples = true

[[example]]
name = "custom_icon"
required-features = ["tokio"]
doc-scrape-examples = true

[[example]]
name = "about_to_show"
required-features = ["tokio"]
doc-scrape-examples = true

[[example]]
name = "realworld"
required-features = ["tokio"]
doc-scrape-examples = true

[[test]]
name = "tokio"
required-features = ["tokio"]

[[test]]
name = "smol"
required-features = ["async-io"]

[[test]]
name = "blocking"
required-features = ["blocking"]
